integrity: Standalone proof, original-bracket enumeration, independent extension-field calculation, reproducible outputs, and content hashes accompany the result.
scientific_limitations: Applies to Lie-bracket fibers in the six-dimensional mirabolic algebra over finite fields; no higher-rank formula or group-commutator count. Exhaustive numerical checks are finite, not a general proof. Historical priority and independent verification remain open.
title: Prescribed Lie-bracket fibers of the two-dimensional mirabolic algebra over finite fields
